skill_name: Create a persuasive argument which explains why our company should adopt a bi-annual meeting.
workflow: Having bi-annual meetings is beneficial for any company as it encourages regular check-ins and promotes team cohesion within the company. By holding bi-annual meetings, we can re-evaluate our goals and objectives, assess team performance, provide feedback to teams and employees, discover potential improvement areas, and brainstorm innovative solutions or ideas. Moreover, bi-annual meetings are also powerful tools for improving communication, motivation, and collaboration between different teams
